summary_1line: Krishna consoles the grieving women, prepares Arjuna for the night, and secretly resolves to ensure Arjuna can fulfill his vow to kill Jayadratha next day.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna sprinkles water on the fainting Subhadra as Draupadi and Uttara weep beside her in the dim war camp.
Krishna meditates alone at night in the Pandava camp, weapons glinting nearby while the camp stays sleepless with worry.
Krishna instructs Daruka to ready his chariot with the Garuda standard and celestial weapons under the night sky.
